scope: Narrow integration review of four Core files and two native design supports; authorized minimal follow-up implementation.

sources.rootAdvance: The compare 5e55...71e43 changed no Core/support files in this review.

verdict.production: No demonstrated production guard/security regression in this overlap. local/entry.ts still calls prepareSfLocalWorkspace for the local-operator host runtime; the workspace helper and native fixture are byte-identical between the reviewed root and Design.
verdict.core: The original three consumers differ only by app-node-system versus app-node-filesystem. The original leaf differs only by its explanatory comment. The reviewed root had one leaf, not duplicate instantiated modules; the collision risk arises if both fronts are composed without reconciliation.
verdict.fixture: The reviewed root's native-host used realpath(workspace) for E2E metadata. That resolves the path but is not equivalent to repeating physical-directory, owner/mode and before/after identity checks. The follow-up calls the existing prepareSfLocalWorkspace instead and exports the canonical workspace field in both paired supports.

sourceEvidence.observation: Line78 calls prepareSfLocalWorkspace(loaded.directory) under operator && context.createHostRuntime before runtime discovery.
Validates installation, validates/creates workspace, checks installation dev/ino/uid/mode before/after. Same blob in root and Design.
Private-directory validator checks physical ancestry, ownership/mode, symlinks, opened-descriptor identity and before/after identity. Existing validator reused unchanged.
Same fixture blob in both sources; actual isolated native CLI starts with private mkdtemp installation.

verification.remoteReadback: Both commits fetched and all exact patches inspected; final effect directory contains app-node-filesystem only. Four Core result blob SHAs equal the Design source blobs.
verification.boundedConsumerRead: Read34 current specs/support files directly under e2e/sucafina and design-support. No external DesignInstallation.directory consumer was found in those files; paired supports were changed together. This is not a claim of a repository-wide textual search.
verification.runtime: No local tests, build or typecheck and no CI run by this agent. Root owns final process/bootstrap/native/E2E type qualification on the combined candidate.
verification.evidenceReuse: Earlier green runs remain evidence for their own bytes; new canonical-name/revalidation/notes changes are pending combined qualification.

risks: The E2E metadata field is an internal contract changed in both producers and consumers. Final E2E typecheck and actual bootstrap must confirm any consumer outside the bounded source read.
The second validation can deliberately fail a fixture whose private physical workspace identity or permissions changed after startup.
Byte parity of four Core files is not qualification of the full Design source or any unmerged Design features.
